digest.component_or_area: snapshot compaction and orphan event handling
propositions: Natural fold operations retire and cite orphan event UUIDs without replaying their effects, causing repairable damage to become silent and undetectable loss after threshold crossing.

Fold must exclude fsck-defined orphans (pre-snapshot events not cited in prior snapshot) from both retirement and source_event_uuids citation, leaving them live so repair windows survive indefinitely.
The shared orphan predicate (is_snapshot_orphan) must be extracted and reused between compact_txn and fsck_scan to prevent definition drift.
Routing parity gate in repair_or_plan must block whole-ticket rebuild when any HUMAN_TRIAGE orphan is present, matching fsck --repair behavior instead of rebuilding unconditionally.
